# Properties of leani

日本語版: [SPEC.ja.md](SPEC.ja.md)

Each user story in `stories.toml` (who leani helps, and how), followed by the tests
that check it. Every test runs in `cargo nextest run` (`uv run pytest` for the kernel
layer). The number of items changes only when a story or a test is added or removed.

    cargo run -p spec

45 stories, 481 tests. In parentheses: where the test is
(layer / describe).

## A. Try expressions

### A1 I want to see the value of an expression right away, without making a file and running lake env lean

- Shows the value when an expression is entered (engine / Evaluating expressions)
- Shows the value when an expression with a form feed in a string is entered (engine / Evaluating expressions)
- Shows the value of the unchanged string when an expression with a multi-line string is entered (engine / Evaluating expressions)
- Runs the action and shows its output when an IO expression is entered (engine / Evaluating expressions)
- Runs the block as IO without an error when a do block mixing BaseIO and IO actions is entered (engine / Evaluating expressions)
- Wraps it in do and runs it without an error when an expression with a left arrow is entered outside do (engine / Evaluating expressions)
- Runs it as IO without an error when an expression with a left arrow on a BaseIO action is entered (engine / Evaluating expressions)
- Judges a line without indentation or a leading pipe as a separate input (parsing / Judging continuation lines)
- Judges input that parses as a command as a complete command (parsing / Judging whether the input is complete)
- Judges input that parses only as a term as a complete term (parsing / Judging whether the input is complete)
- Judges an error about an action written outside do as an action outside do (parsing / Actions outside do)
- Judges other errors as not about an action outside do (parsing / Actions outside do)
- Returns None before a blank line arrives (parsing / Cutting out responses)
- Returns the JSON before a blank line once the blank line arrives (parsing / Cutting out responses)
- Reads JSON with a blank line in a string value and keeps the value (parsing / Cutting out responses)
- Indents every line except those that start inside a string (parsing / Replacing sorry)
- Judges the line after a quote in a comment as outside strings (parsing / Replacing sorry)
- Judges the line after a quote in a char literal or a name escape as outside strings (parsing / Replacing sorry)
- Judges the outer string as still open after a string in an interpolation closes (parsing / Replacing sorry)
- Judges a name escape that does not close on its line as ended at the line end (parsing / Replacing sorry)
- Returns one judgment per line for any input (parsing / Replacing sorry)

### A2 When an expression cannot be evaluated, I want to know why (noncomputable or no Repr)

- Shows why it cannot be evaluated and the type when a term without Repr is entered (engine / Evaluating expressions)
- Shows why it cannot be evaluated and the type when a noncomputable constant is entered (engine / Evaluating expressions)
- Returns a reason mentioning Repr for an error about a missing Repr instance (parsing / Reasons a value cannot be evaluated)
- Returns a reason mentioning noncomputable for an error that suggests noncomputable (parsing / Reasons a value cannot be evaluated)
- Returns None for an error unrelated to evaluation (parsing / Reasons a value cannot be evaluated)

### A3 I want to know how long a result takes, to find the slow computations

- Toggles whether results show the run time each time :time runs (engine / Run time)

### A4 I want to stop a slow computation with Ctrl-C and go on without losing the earlier declarations

- Shows correct values for later input when the replay after an interrupt is interrupted again (engine / Recovering from engine crashes)
- Replays the declarations when :restart runs after a restart was interrupted (engine / Recovering from engine crashes)
- Restores the file and the declarations when :restart runs after reloading the file was interrupted (engine / Recovering from engine crashes)
- Skips the entered line and says so when the replay after a crash is interrupted with Ctrl-C (engine / When a replay stops partway)
- Keeps the previous environment and declarations when loading a file is interrupted (engine / Interrupting a load)
- Cancels the load and keeps earlier declarations when reapplying init during :l is interrupted (engine / Interrupting a load)
- Says the proof can resume when a tactic is interrupted, and replaces the sorry after :prove (engine / When the engine changes during a tactic)
- Says the declaration did not run and records nothing when Ctrl-C stops its judgment (engine / When the completeness judgment is interrupted)
- Restores the undone declaration when Ctrl-C stops the judgment on the empty line ending a continuation (engine / When the completeness judgment is interrupted)
- Queues the undone declaration after the pending ones when Ctrl-C stops a replay after an engine crash (engine / When the completeness judgment is interrupted)
- Keeps declarations pending until :restart when Ctrl-C interrupts the return to the original environment (engine / When switching fails)
- Reloads the loaded file on :restart when Ctrl-C interrupts the return to the original environment (engine / When switching fails)
- Stops the evaluation, fails the cell, restarts the engine and replays earlier declarations when it is interrupted (kernel / Engine crashes and interrupts)
- Interrupts the evaluation, restarts the engine and replays earlier declarations when Ctrl-C is pressed during it (terminal / Line editing)

### A5 When there is an error, I want to see where in the line the input is wrong

- Shows the error position within the original input when an expression with a left arrow fails (engine / Evaluating expressions)
- Returns the range shifted back by the lines and columns that wrapping in #eval added (parsing / Range of an error position)
- Shifts back only the line, not the column, for a line that starts inside a string (parsing / Range of an error position)
- Returns None for a position outside the lines (parsing / Range of an error position)
- Limits the width of a range to the length of the line (parsing / Range of an error position)
- Counts a full-width character as two columns for the caret position and length (parsing / Range of an error position)
- Keeps a tab before the caret as a tab instead of spaces (parsing / Range of an error position)

- Replaces the project and imports of the environment when a name, project and imports are given (parsing / Choosing the environment to start)
- Chooses the plain environment with the given imports when only imports are given (parsing / Choosing the environment to start)
- Uses the engine of the environment if it has one and the top-level engine otherwise (parsing / Choosing the environment to start)
- Uses the top-level engine when only imports are given without a name (parsing / Choosing the environment to start)
- Returns Install for a successful startup of the target environment (parsing / Choosing the next step after a startup result in :env)
- Returns GoBack to the original environment for a failed or interrupted startup of the target environment (parsing / Choosing the next step after a startup result in :env)
- Returns Install for a successful startup of the original environment (parsing / Choosing the next step after a startup result in :env)
- Returns Suspend for an interrupted startup of the original environment (parsing / Choosing the next step after a startup result in :env)
- Returns Lose for a failed startup of the original environment (parsing / Choosing the next step after a startup result in :env)
- Leads to at most two startups, the target and then the original environment, and returns Install only when one succeeds for any startup results (parsing / Choosing the next step after a startup result in :env)
- Returns the value of -e or --env as the environment name (parsing / Command-line options)
- Returns an error naming the option for -e, -i, or -p without a value (parsing / Command-line options)
- Changes the prompt to the one set for the environment when :env switches environments (terminal / Switching environments)

### G6 In a Lake project, I want to use its library without writing a config

- Judges the cache as stale when lean-toolchain is newer than the cache (parsing / Preparation before startup)
- Chooses the plain environment with the given imports when only imports are given (parsing / Choosing the environment to start)
- Returns an empty config when the config file does not exist (parsing / Loading the config file)
- Prepends the engine olean path to LEAN_PATH from lake env, or the inherited one without a project (parsing / Getting lake env)
- Returns the cache without running lake env when getting it twice for the same project (parsing / Getting lake env)
- Reports the reason if lake is missing or lake env fails (parsing / Getting lake env)
- Shows that Ctrl-C can interrupt lake env when it runs (parsing / Getting lake env)
- Returns the result of lake env when it takes longer than the engine setup timeout (parsing / Getting lake env)
- Interrupts when Ctrl-C is pressed while lake env runs (parsing / Getting lake env)
- Reports the failure and leaves no temp file if the lake env result cannot be saved (parsing / Getting lake env)
- Returns the parent directory with a lakefile when searching from a subdirectory (parsing / Detecting Lake projects)
- Returns None without a lakefile (parsing / Detecting Lake projects)
- Returns the lean_lib names from lakefile.toml (parsing / Detecting Lake projects)
- Returns the lean_lib names from lakefile.lean (parsing / Detecting Lake projects)
- Returns nothing from a lakefile.toml that is not valid TOML (parsing / Detecting Lake projects)
- Names the environment after the enclosing Lake project and imports its lean_lib without a config (parsing / Detecting Lake projects)
- Names the environment after the project directory for any form of the -p path (parsing / Detecting Lake projects)
- Uses the plain environment with no project outside a Lake project (parsing / Detecting Lake projects)
- Uses the given imports instead of lean_lib (parsing / Detecting Lake projects)
- Returns every import in order for repeated -i and --import (parsing / Command-line options)
- Returns an error naming the option for -e, -i, or -p without a value (parsing / Command-line options)

## H. Learn the commands

### H1 I want to see the list of commands, and be told when I type a command that does not exist

- Returns command names listed in HELP for a word starting with a colon (completion / Tab completion of commands)
- Extracts only alphabetic command names from the HELP text (completion / Tab completion of commands)
- Shows the command list when :help runs (engine / The command list)
- Shows the proof mode help when :help runs in proof mode (engine / The command list)
- Says the command is unknown and keeps the session when a nonexistent command is entered (engine / The command list)
- Says a name is required when :p runs without a name (engine / Showing types and definitions)
- Offers command names starting with the typed part as candidates when completing a command name (kernel / Completion)

## J. Use in a notebook

### J1 I want to run cells in a notebook as in the terminal, and stop at a cell with an error

- Runs the unfinished declaration when the cell ends (engine / End of a notebook cell)
- Shows that :} is missing without running the block when the cell ends inside :{ (engine / End of a notebook cell)
- Shows the value when a cell with #eval runs (kernel / Running cells)
- Shows the value when a cell evaluates a function declared in the previous cell (kernel / Running cells)
- Sets the status to error when a cell with an error runs (kernel / Running cells)
- Returns ok without showing anything when a silent cell runs (kernel / Running cells)
- Returns ok without showing anything when a process from an earlier cell writes during a silent cell (kernel / Running cells)
- Replaces the sorry in the theorem when the proof is finished in proof mode (kernel / Running cells)
- Runs a tactic together with the next line when its bracket is not closed in proof mode (kernel / Running cells)
- Shows the value without changing the string when a cell with a multi-line string runs (kernel / Running cells)
- Replaces the sorry with the multi-line string unchanged when it is sent with exact in proof mode (kernel / Running cells)
- Says the unfinished input was discarded and keeps the previous tactic when a command is sent before its continuation is finished in proof mode (kernel / Running cells)
- Runs every tactic and completes the proof when tactics separated by semicolons are sent in proof mode (kernel / Running cells)
- Shows a parse error at the position in the input when an unparsable tactic is sent in proof mode (kernel / Running cells)
- Evaluates a raw string across two lines as one string with a newline when its cell runs (kernel / Running cells)
- Fails showing :} is missing and runs the next cell when a cell leaves a multi-line block open (kernel / Running cells)
- Shows stdout and stderr in the cell with status ok when a command run with :! exits with a nonzero code (kernel / Running cells)
- Shows the abbreviations for a symbol in the cell when :abbrev runs with it (kernel / Running cells)
- Fails showing a pattern is needed when :loogle runs without a pattern (kernel / Running cells)
- Shows that it does nothing in a notebook and runs the next cell when :q runs (kernel / Running cells)
- Evaluates the expression without changing the string when a cell has a string with a form feed (kernel / Running cells)
- Fails the cell with the error and retries startup in the next cell if the config has an error (kernel / Startup and restart failures)
- Runs lean without a timeout and returns the version it prints when looking up the local toolchain (kernel / Lean version)
- Replaces stable with the version that the stable lean reports if the project uses stable (kernel / Lean version)
- Returns the value in the lean-toolchain of the engine directory as it is without running lean if the config sets the engine (kernel / Lean version)
- Writes a kernel.json that starts leani.kernel with the current Python and sets FORCE_COLOR to 1 when install runs (kernel / Registering the kernel)

### J2 In a notebook, I want Tab to complete names and abbreviations

- Offers constant names as candidates when a partial name is completed (kernel / Completion)
- Removes the name from the candidates when :undo undoes its declaration (kernel / Completion)
- Offers the added name as a candidate but not the undone one when a declaration is added after :undo (kernel / Completion)
- Offers the symbol as the first candidate when an abbreviation is completed (kernel / Completion)
- Offers command names starting with the typed part as candidates when completing a command name (kernel / Completion)
- Offers only .lean files as candidates when the path after :l on a cell's second line is completed (kernel / Completion)
- Turns a candidate with only the rest of a word into the whole word (kernel / Completions in the Jupyter form)
- Appends a slash to a directory candidate (kernel / Completions in the Jupyter form)
- Replaces the whole typed name with a constant name candidate (kernel / Completions in the Jupyter form)
- Replaces only the name after an escape in a string with a constant name candidate (kernel / Completions in the Jupyter form)
- Replaces only the part after a symbol before a name with a constant name candidate (kernel / Completions in the Jupyter form)
- Replaces only the part after a character not allowed in Lean names with a constant name candidate (kernel / Completions in the Jupyter form)
- Returns the cursor position and an empty list if there is no candidate (kernel / Completions in the Jupyter form)
- Returns the abbreviation name before the cursor (parsing / Abbreviation candidates)
- Returns None outside an abbreviation (parsing / Abbreviation candidates)
- Puts the exact match symbol first and includes those of abbreviations starting with the name (parsing / Abbreviation candidates)

### J3 In a notebook, I do not want to lose declarations when the engine crashes or is interrupted

- Keeps earlier declarations for the next cell when the engine crashes (kernel / Engine crashes and interrupts)
- Stops the evaluation, fails the cell, restarts the engine and replays earlier declarations when it is interrupted (kernel / Engine crashes and interrupts)
- Fails the cell with the error and retries startup in the next cell when the engine does not start (kernel / Startup and restart failures)
- Fails the cell and starts the engine again in the next cell when a restart fails or :env cannot return to the original environment (kernel / Startup and restart failures)
- Fails the cell with an internal error, discards the unfinished block and keeps the session when an unexpected exception occurs (kernel / Startup and restart failures)

### X3 I want people who do not read Japanese to be able to read how to use and develop leani

- Returns an error naming the unchanged document when a commit changes only one document of a pair (parsing / Checking documents in two languages)
- Returns Ok when a commit changes both documents of a pair (parsing / Checking documents in two languages)

- Returns an error naming the document when it has no counterpart in the other language (parsing / Checking documents in two languages)
